summary: Fallback when the extends expression is a runtime value or has observable evaluation/property-access semantics incompatible with a fixed C# base type.

target.notes: Evaluate the extends expression at class definition time, validate it as JavaScript requires, and build constructor/prototype links in the runtime object model.

semantics.base_prototype_read: observable and may invoke proxy/getter behavior

caveats: C# base types are metadata fixed at compile time.

tests.name: runtime-selected base
tests.input: const B = Math.random() ? class {m(){return 1}} : class {m(){return 2}}; class D extends B {}
tests.expected_behavior: D inherits whichever constructor object B denotes at runtime

tests.name: edge: invalid extends value
tests.expected_behavior: throws TypeError while evaluating the class definition
